source: CrowdFrameList $A4B54 (showcrowd L52175, sub_16246 L52223), 118 raw tiles

space.1-31: rink map pixels (rink/map.json; map_px = rink_x + 192, 368 - rink_y)
space.32-62: screen pixels of the 256x224 side view (horizontal mode, sflags bit 7)

order: parts are assembled figures (pieces composited in VDP link order); they do not overlap

group_notes.crowd: crowdframe low byte: fans over the stands all round the rink; 1-13 small moves (22-33 hardware sprites), 14-18 many fans standing (76-80)
group_notes.flash: crowdframe high byte: camera flashes (2x2-tile stars, line 0) at scattered seats
group_notes.box_away: PBnum low nibble n: frames $1A..$1A+n-1, one seated player each (right-hand box, map y 286-338; jersey line 3, legs line 2)
group_notes.box_home: PBnum high nibble n: frames $1D..$1D+n-1 (box map y 375-426, line 2)

cd0_note: updatecrowdf: row = (min(crowdlevel >> 1, $7F) & $60) / $20, column = crowdstep / 2; [frame, delay mask], crowdcnt = mask + (VDP counter & mask)
